result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
If you're running a small business in Australia, my top recommendation is **Xero** for most businesses. However, **MYOB** may be better value if you have employees, while **Rounded** is worth considering if you're a sole trader.

The best choice depends on your business size, whether you employ staff, and how much bookkeeping you want to do yourself.

## My top 5 accounting software picks

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent bank reconciliation and invoicing.
- GST and BAS reporting.
- Payroll and accountant access.
- Lots of integrations with other business apps.

Best for: Small businesses planning to grow.

Australian plans start around A\$37/month.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for businesses with employees)

- Australian tax and payroll functionality.
- BAS and GST reporting.
- Good inventory and job management options.

Best for: Businesses with employees, stock or more complex operations.

Business Pro around A\$70/month.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![QuickBooks Online Subscription
– Youngblüm Consulting, LLC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZgHrB8oigEufRyuFGAnJb5xLCv8JTTFTuh-tJroDHKA-im6xXYHUKY5IyXqMXAn4XiAmA9iGGDzvBmRzmuCP5nnYiezowZhOKrQixuB8tQOCn-kwmHGQPey_5_wckO7vbwWRLyIGGAJrospfP2duINJHsMT-PeUh6ztD0dM7ZAm_N6XnyQYoxFtq7J7pZOxm?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Straightforward invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Good integrations.

Best for: Small businesses wanting straightforward bookkeeping.

[QuickBooks Australia](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Australian Wave accounting alternative | Rounded](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/iHTtuzfR8afbUEsOjANr7BZNtUaTCbI-w6hfNd2ZhvSmWv3z_Zvt00omzgbR_d7wj31enSdNcHeFhS2u3r8tS9sTIjjdCP1IzsOGdZLYvJeXIDYspK9sCEvR9R3F9LrBksX2QaPuFchF_4cDBhe3CGWQmXc8CTsjGg1d1BCTyul3jvIxZUfAFTLQydw-K0Yk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Rounded**

- Simple invoicing.
- Expense tracking.
- GST tracking and BAS preparation.

Best for: Sole traders and freelancers.

[Rounded website](https://rounded.com.au/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Affordable accounting solution.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Good if you already use other Zoho products.

Best for: Startups and budget-conscious businesses.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best for | Ease of use |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Xero | Most small businesses | Very easy |
| MYOB | Staff and payroll | Moderate |
| QuickBooks | General bookkeeping | Easy |
| Rounded | Sole traders | Very easy |
| Zoho Books | Low-cost accounting | Easy |


One important consideration in Australia: make sure your software supports GST, BAS, Single Touch Payroll (STP) if you employ staff, and the relevant ATO reporting requirements.
